module Intro.Asset.Trade where

import Intro.Asset

template Trade
  with
    baseAssetCid : ContractId Asset
    baseAsset : Asset
    quoteApprovalCid : ContractId TransferApproval
    quoteAsset : Asset
  where
    signatory baseAsset.owner
    observer quoteAsset.owner

    choice Trade_Cancel
        : ()
        controller baseAsset.owner
        do
          return ()

    choice Trade_Reject
        : ()
        controller quoteAsset.owner
        do
          return ()

-- TRADE_SETTLE_BEGIN
    choice Trade_Settle
      : (ContractId Asset, ContractId Asset)
      with
        quoteAssetCid : ContractId Asset
        baseApprovalCid : ContractId TransferApproval
      controller quoteAsset.owner
      do
        fetchedBaseAsset <- fetch baseAssetCid
        assertMsg
          "Base asset mismatch"
          (baseAsset == fetchedBaseAsset with
            observers = baseAsset.observers)

        fetchedQuoteAsset <- fetch quoteAssetCid
        assertMsg
          "Quote asset mismatch"
          (quoteAsset == fetchedQuoteAsset with
            observers = quoteAsset.observers)

        transferredBaseCid <- exercise
          baseApprovalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with
            assetCid = baseAssetCid

        transferredQuoteCid <- exercise
          quoteApprovalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with
            assetCid = quoteAssetCid

        return (transferredBaseCid, transferredQuoteCid)
-- TRADE_SETTLE_END

module Intro.Asset where

data SplitResult = SplitResult with
  splitAsset : ContractId Asset
  remainder : ContractId Asset
    deriving (Eq, Show)

-- ASSET_BEGIN
template Asset
  with
    issuer : Party
    owner : Party
    symbol : Text
    quantity : Decimal
    observers : [Party]
  where
    signatory issuer, owner
    ensure quantity > 0.0

    observer observers
-- ASSET_END


-- MERGE_SPLIT_BEGIN
    choice Split
      : SplitResult
      with
        splitQuantity : Decimal
      controller owner
      do
        splitAsset <- create this with
          quantity = splitQuantity
        remainder <- create this with
          quantity = quantity - splitQuantity
        return SplitResult with
          splitAsset
          remainder

    choice Merge
      : ContractId Asset
      with
        otherCid : ContractId Asset
      controller owner
      do
        other <- fetch otherCid
        assertMsg
          "Merge failed: issuer does not match"
          (issuer == other.issuer)
        assertMsg
          "Merge failed: owner does not match"
          (owner == other.owner)
        assertMsg
          "Merge failed: symbol does not match"
          (symbol == other.symbol)
        archive otherCid
        create this with
          quantity = quantity + other.quantity
-- MERGE_SPLIT_END

    choice ProposeTransfer
      : ContractId TransferProposal
      with
        newOwner : Party
      controller owner
      do
        create TransferProposal with
          asset = this
          newOwner

    choice  SetObservers
      : ContractId Asset
      with
        newObservers : [Party]
      controller owner
      do
        create this with
          observers = newObservers

template TransferProposal
  with
    asset : Asset
    newOwner : Party
  where
    signatory (signatory asset)
    observer newOwner

    choice TransferProposal_Accept
        : ContractId Asset
        controller asset.issuer, newOwner
        do
          create asset with
            owner = newOwner

    choice TransferProposal_Cancel
        : ContractId Asset
        controller asset.owner
        do
          create asset with
            observers = []

    choice TransferProposal_Reject
        : ContractId Asset
        controller newOwner
        do
          create asset

template TransferApproval
  with
    asset : Asset
    newOwner : Party
  where
    signatory asset.issuer
    observer asset.owner, newOwner

    choice TransferApproval_Cancel
        : ()
        controller asset.owner
        do
          return ()

    choice TransferApproval_Reject
        : ()
        controller newOwner
        do
          return ()

    choice TransferApproval_Transfer
        : ContractId Asset
        with
          assetCid : ContractId Asset
        controller asset.owner, newOwner
        do
          sentAsset <- fetch assetCid
          assertMsg
            "Transfer failed: Assets do not match."
            (asset == sentAsset with
              observers = asset.observers
            )
          archive assetCid
          create asset with
            owner = newOwner
            observers = []

module Test.Intro.Asset where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role

import Test.Intro.Asset.Role

test_asset = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, aha, ahb), assetCid) <- test_issuance

  tp <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid ProposeTransfer with
      newOwner = bob

  assetCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd ahb Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = tp

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset == Asset with
      issuer = bank
      owner = bob
      symbol = "USD"
      quantity = 100.0
      observers = []
        )

test_split = do
  (setupResult@(alice, bob, bank, _, _), assetCid) <- test_issuance

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = -30.0

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 0.0

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 101.0

  splitResult <- submit alice do

module Intro.Asset where

data SplitResult = SplitResult with

    choice Split
      : SplitResult
      with

        remainder <- create this with

      : ContractId Asset
      with

      do

        assertMsg

          "Merge failed: owner does not match"
          (owner == other.owner)

          "Merge failed: symbol does not match"
          (symbol == other.symbol)
        archive otherCid
        create this with
          quantity = quantity + other.quantity
-- MERGE_SPLIT_END

      : ContractId TransferProposal
      with

      with

      do

    newOwner : Party

@@
+module Test.Intro.Asset.Trade where
+
+import Daml.Script
+import Intro.Asset
+import Intro.Asset.Trade
+
+setupTrade = do
+  alice <- allocateParty \"Alice\"
+  bob <- allocateParty \"Bob\"
+  carol <- allocateParty \"Carol\"
+  let baseAsset = Asset with
+        issuer = alice
+        owner = alice
+        symbol = \"BASE\"
+        quantity = 10.0
+        observers = []
+  let quoteAsset = Asset with
+        issuer = bob
+        owner = bob
+        symbol = \"QUOTE\"
+        quantity = 25.0
+        observers = []

module Test.Intro.Asset.Trade where

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Trade

setupTrade = do
  alice <- allocateParty \"Alice\"
  bob <- allocateParty \"Bob\"
  carol <- allocateParty \"Carol\"
  let baseAsset = Asset with
        issuer = alice
        owner = alice
        symbol = \"BASE\"
        quantity = 10.0
        observers = []
  let quoteAsset = Asset with
        issuer = bob
        owner = bob
        symbol = \"QUOTE\"
        quantity = 25.0
        observers = []
  baseCid <- submit alice do createCmd baseAsset
  quoteCid <- submit bob do createCmd quoteAsset
  baseApprovalCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset = baseAsset; newOwner = bob
  quoteApprovalCid <- submit bob do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset = quoteAsset; newOwner = alice
  tradeCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd Trade with
      baseAssetCid = baseCid
      baseAsset
      quoteApprovalCid
      quoteAsset
  pure ((alice, bob, carol), (baseCid, quoteCid),
        (baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid), tradeCid, (baseAsset, quoteAsset))

test_trade_settles_both_assets = do
  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid), tradeCid, (baseAsset, quoteAsset)) <- setupTrade
  (receivedBaseCid, receivedQuoteCid) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  Some receivedBase <- queryContractId bob receivedBaseCid
  Some receivedQuote <- queryContractId alice receivedQuoteCid
  assert (receivedBase == baseAsset with owner = bob; observers = [])
  assert (receivedQuote == quoteAsset with owner = alice; observers = [])
  None <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  None <- queryContractId bob quoteCid
  None <- queryContractId alice tradeCid
  None <- queryContractId alice baseApprovalCid
  None <- queryContractId bob quoteApprovalCid

  submitMustFail alice do

      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  submitMustFail carol do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  submitMustFail bob do exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Cancel
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Reject
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid

  submit bob do exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Reject

  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid

  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd badTradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid

test_trade_rejects_wrong_quote_asset = do

module Test.Intro.Asset.Trade where

import Daml.Script
import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Trade

setupTrade = do
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  carol <- allocateParty "Carol"
  let baseAsset = Asset with
        issuer = alice
        owner = alice
        symbol = "BASE"
        quantity = 10.0
        observers = []
  let quoteAsset = Asset with
        issuer = bob
        owner = bob
        symbol = "QUOTE"
        quantity = 25.0
        observers = []
  baseCid <- submit alice do createCmd baseAsset
  quoteCid <- submit bob do createCmd quoteAsset
  baseApprovalCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset = baseAsset; newOwner = bob
  quoteApprovalCid <- submit bob do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset = quoteAsset; newOwner = alice
  tradeCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd Trade with
      baseAssetCid = baseCid
      baseAsset
      quoteApprovalCid
      quoteAsset
  pure ((alice, bob, carol), (baseCid, quoteCid),
        (baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid), tradeCid, (baseAsset, quoteAsset))

test_trade_settles_both_assets = do
  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid), tradeCid, (baseAsset, quoteAsset)) <- setupTrade
  (receivedBaseCid, receivedQuoteCid) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  Some receivedBase <- queryContractId bob receivedBaseCid
  Some receivedQuote <- queryContractId alice receivedQuoteCid
  assert (receivedBase == baseAsset with owner = bob; observers = [])
  assert (receivedQuote == quoteAsset with owner = alice; observers = [])
  None <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  None <- queryContractId bob quoteCid
  None <- queryContractId alice tradeCid
  None <- queryContractId alice baseApprovalCid
  None <- queryContractId bob quoteApprovalCid

test_trade_authorization = do
  ((alice, bob, carol), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, _), tradeCid, _) <- setupTrade
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  submitMustFail carol do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  submitMustFail bob do exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Cancel
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Reject
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid

test_trade_cancel = do
  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid), tradeCid, _) <- setupTrade
  submit alice do exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Cancel
  None <- queryContractId alice tradeCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteApprovalCid
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid

test_trade_reject = do
  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid), tradeCid, _) <- setupTrade
  submit bob do exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Reject
  None <- queryContractId alice tradeCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteApprovalCid

test_trade_rejects_wrong_base_snapshot = do
  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid), _, (baseAsset, quoteAsset)) <- setupTrade
  badTradeCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd Trade with
      baseAssetCid = baseCid
      baseAsset = baseAsset with quantity = 11.0
      quoteApprovalCid
      quoteAsset
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd badTradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice badTradeCid

test_trade_rejects_wrong_quote_snapshot = do
  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid), _, (baseAsset, quoteAsset)) <- setupTrade
  badTradeCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd Trade with
      baseAssetCid = baseCid
      baseAsset
      quoteApprovalCid
      quoteAsset = quoteAsset with symbol = "NOT QUOTE"
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd badTradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid

test_trade_rejects_wrong_quote_asset = do
  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, _), tradeCid, _) <- setupTrade
  wrongQuoteCid <- submit bob do
    createCmd Asset with
      issuer = bob
      owner = bob
      symbol = "OTHER"
      quantity = 25.0
      observers = []
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = wrongQuoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice tradeCid

test_trade_rejects_wrong_base_approval = do
  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    _, tradeCid, (baseAsset, _)) <- setupTrade
  wrongApprovalCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd TransferApproval with
      asset = baseAsset with symbol = "OTHER"
      newOwner = bob
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid = wrongApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid

test_trade_rolls_back_if_quote_approval_fails = do

    createCmd Trade with

      baseAsset

  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob wrongQuoteApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice tradeCid

    (baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid), tradeCid, (baseAsset, quoteAsset)) <- setupTrade

    exerciseCmd baseCid SetObservers with newObservers = [carol]
  changedQuoteCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd quoteCid SetObservers with newObservers = [carol]
  (receivedBaseCid, receivedQuoteCid) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = changedQuoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  Some receivedBase <- queryContractId bob receivedBaseCid
  Some receivedQuote <- queryContractId alice receivedQuoteCid
  assert (receivedBase == baseAsset with owner = bob; observers = [])
  assert (receivedQuote == quoteAsset with owner = alice; observers = [])
  None <- queryContractId alice changedBaseCid
  None <- queryContractId bob changedQuoteCid
  None <- queryContractId alice baseApprovalCid
  None <- queryContractId bob quoteApprovalCid
EOF

  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, _), tradeCid, _) <- setupTrade
  wrongQuoteCid <- submit bob do
    createCmd Asset with
      issuer = bob
      owner = bob
      symbol = "OTHER"
      quantity = 25.0
      observers = []
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = wrongQuoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice tradeCid

test_trade_rejects_wrong_base_approval = do
  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    _, tradeCid, (baseAsset, _)) <- setupTrade
  wrongApprovalCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd TransferApproval with
      asset = baseAsset with symbol = "OTHER"
      newOwner = bob
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid = wrongApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid

test_trade_rolls_back_if_quote_approval_fails = do
  ((alice, bob, carol), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, _), _, (baseAsset, quoteAsset)) <- setupTrade
  wrongQuoteApprovalCid <- submit bob do
    createCmd TransferApproval with
      asset = quoteAsset with quantity = 26.0
      newOwner = carol
  tradeCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd Trade with
      baseAssetCid = baseCid
      baseAsset
      quoteApprovalCid = wrongQuoteApprovalCid
      quoteAsset
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = quoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice baseApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId bob wrongQuoteApprovalCid
  Some _ <- queryContractId alice tradeCid

test_trade_allows_observer_changes = do
  ((alice, bob, carol), (baseCid, quoteCid),
    (baseApprovalCid, quoteApprovalCid), tradeCid, (baseAsset, quoteAsset)) <- setupTrade
  changedBaseCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd baseCid SetObservers with newObservers = [carol]
  changedQuoteCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd quoteCid SetObservers with newObservers = [carol]
  (receivedBaseCid, receivedQuoteCid) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = changedQuoteCid
      baseApprovalCid
  Some receivedBase <- queryContractId bob receivedBaseCid
  Some receivedQuote <- queryContractId alice receivedQuoteCid
  assert (receivedBase == baseAsset with owner = bob; observers = [])
  assert (receivedQuote == quoteAsset with owner = alice; observers = [])
  None <- queryContractId alice changedBaseCid
  None <- queryContractId bob changedQuoteCid
  None <- queryContractId alice baseApprovalCid
  None <- queryContractId bob quoteApprovalCid

  ((alice, bob, _), (baseCid, quoteCid),

  Some _ <- queryContractId bob quoteCid
